clue.text: Used to support the worker

parts.note: to second a proposal is to support it
a hand is a worker, as in a farmhand

explanation.surface: Something old pressed into service to prop up a labourer.
explanation.definitionFit: Goods that are used have had a previous owner, which is what secondhand describes.

clue.text: Situation calling for sound vision

indicators.note: the word sound tells us the next word is to be taken as it is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: sight is the faculty of vision

explanation.surface: A position that demands good eyesight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'calling for' is only a link here; 'sound' signals that SIGHT is said aloud, giving the same-sounding word.
explanation.definitionFit: A site is a location or setting, so a synonym for situation in the sense of place.

clue.text: A repository on certain occasions

indicators.note: occasions here works as a verb meaning brings about, so the preceding words are made into something new

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A storage place that is used only now and then.
explanation.walkthrough: 'occasions' looks like a plural noun but acts as the anagram signal: ON plus CERTAIN rearranges into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A container holds and stores things, so it is a kind of storehouse.

clue.text: Made a record and celebrated

definitions.meaning: to note something is to write it down

explanation.surface: Someone wrote things down and threw a party.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both jotted down in writing and well known or famous.

clue.text: Has a row, being more quick-tempered

parts.note: taken as written
a tier is a row, as of seats in a theatre

explanation.surface: Someone quarrels, being the shorter-fused of the pair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'row' reads as a quarrel in the surface, fitting 'quick-tempered', but it is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Hasty can mean rash or irritable, so its comparative suits someone with a shorter fuse.

clue.text: Round figures

parts.note: round figures suggests approximate numbers, but read literally it is circular symbols such as the zero

explanation.surface: Approximate numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: A zero is written as a circle, so these are literally ring-shaped numerals.

clue.text: A winger's game

definitions.meaning: a bird, a creature with wings, here the songbird
a piece of fun or a prank

explanation.surface: Some player out on the wing has a sport of their own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'winger' suggests a footballer on the wing; it is just a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a songbird and also a frolic or spree, as in doing something for fun.

clue.text: Only a small section is skilled

parts.note: Dept is the short form of department, a section of an organisation, small signalling the abbreviation

explanation.surface: Only one little department has expertise.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Only' is just part of the surface; the wordplay is A plus the abbreviation DEPT.
explanation.definitionFit: An expert or proficient person is described as adept.

clue.text: Sympathy of sorts shown about wrinkles

indicators.note: about means around, so one word goes outside the other

parts.note: kinds are sorts or types
lines are wrinkles on the face

explanation.surface: Compassion of a kind is shown regarding age lines.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sympathy of sorts' reads as one phrase, but the definition stops at 'Sympathy'; 'of' and 'shown' are only joining words.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindliness is warm compassion, the feeling of sympathy toward others.

clue.text: Nice bill a junior minister presented

parts.note: AC is short for account, a bill
a curate is an assistant to a parish priest, so a junior member of the clergy

explanation.surface: A government junior minister introduces a pleasant piece of legislation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nice' means precise or exact here, not pleasant; the junior minister is a churchman, not a politician.
explanation.definitionFit: Nice in its older sense means fine or exact, as in a nice distinction, which is precise.

clue.text: Doctrine that could make a comeback

indicators.note: the word reads the same backwards, so it returns unchanged when turned around

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A belief that might return to fashion.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or belief held as true, which is a doctrine.

clue.text: Shield carved in chosen form

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside another
form means shape, so the letters of the previous word are given a new shape

parts.note: taken as written
cut is a synonym of carved

explanation.surface: A shield sculpted in a selected design.
explanation.walkthrough: 'form' rearranges the six letters of 'chosen' into SCHEON, and 'in' tells us the synonym for carved goes inside it, straight after the S. Scutcheon is a less common form of escutcheon.
explanation.definitionFit: A scutcheon is a variant of escutcheon, the heraldic shield bearing a coat of arms.

clue.text: Port may be taken at lunchtime

definitions.meaning: a town in Kent, one of the old Cinque Ports on the English coast
a midday snack of filling between bread slices

explanation.surface: Port wine might be drunk with lunch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Port' looks like the fortified wine; it is the Kent harbour town.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a Kent coastal town and a filled bread snack eaten at midday.

clue.text: Up to a bit of fun, tilers scamp the job

indicators.note: a bit of means only part of the following words is taken, a run of letters inside them

explanation.surface: Builders botch a roof for a laugh.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scamp the job' only completes the picture of slapdash tilers.
explanation.definitionFit: Until means up to a point in time, as in waiting up to midnight.

clue.text: A delightful fish,

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'A delightful fish, (5,5)', gives wordplay A + CUTE + ANGLE but is cut short after the comma: no definition survives and no scan or search gives the rest.

clue.text: Outline to read prior to a journey

indicators.note: prior to means coming before, so the first piece is placed ahead of the second

parts.note: to con is to study or read carefully
a tour is a journey

explanation.surface: Study the map before setting off.
explanation.definitionFit: A contour is the shape or line marking the edge of something, an outline.

clue.text: Fatigued and browned off

definitions.meaning: cooked too long so it is too brown

explanation.surface: Someone is tired and fed up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'browned off' is British slang for fed up, but here it means cooked too much.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means exhausted from too much effort and also cooked for too long.

clue.text: Quarter some with an old Greek

parts.note: S is south, one quarter of the compass
part means a portion or some
taken as written

explanation.surface: Lodge some people with an ancient Greek.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of Sparta, the ancient city-state in the Peloponnese, was a Spartan.

clue.text: Man forming designs on those patronising him

definitions.text: Man forming designs on those patronising him

parts.words: Man forming designs on those patronising him
parts.note: designs on someone suggests scheming against them, but read literally it is drawing pictures on the skin of paying customers

explanation.surface: A man plotting against the very people who support him.
explanation.definitionFit: This craftsperson inks pictures on clients' skin, who are his patrons.

clue.text: People in the wrong can cause distress

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
men means people

explanation.surface: Those who are mistaken can make others suffer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the wrong' is the legal term for a civil wrong; 'can cause' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Torment is severe suffering, mental or physical, so a stronger word for distress.

clue.text: Having trouble with rent, storm

parts.note: rent as a past participle means torn
ado is fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: A tenant struggling with rent goes on the rampage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rent' looks like money paid to a landlord but is the old past tense of rend.
explanation.definitionFit: A tornado is a violent rotating windstorm.

clue.text: Dicky hustles detectives

indicators.note: dicky is British slang for faulty or unsound, so the next word is broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A faulty character jostles police investigators.
explanation.definitionFit: Sleuths are investigators, a slang word for detectives.

clue.text: Cheat — heartless devil -detained by unpleasant characters

indicators.note: detained by means held inside, so one piece is enclosed by the other

parts.note: swine is a term for nasty people

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letters are removed, leaving only the outside letters

explanation.surface: A cheating, cruel devil held by nasty types.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartless' takes the middle out of devil, leaving its first and last letters D and L, which go inside SWINE.
explanation.definitionFit: To swindle is to defraud someone, and as a noun a fraud, both close to cheat.

clue.text: In modern times anger is publicly displayed

indicators.note: In tells us one piece is placed inside the other

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, marks dates of the modern era
ire is anger

explanation.surface: Nowadays fury is vented openly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In' opens the clue, so it looks like 'In modern times' is one phrase; it is actually the insertion signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something aired has been made public, like a grievance aired in open.

clue.text: Animals trekking back south for long grass

indicators.note: trekking back means walking in the reverse direction, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: deer are animals

explanation.surface: Herds walking back south through tall grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Reeds are tall grasses growing in wetland.

clue.text: Just a slight fall, naturally

parts.note: a slight fall sounds like a stumble, but naturally points to weather, a single drop from the sky

explanation.surface: A minor tumble, of course.
explanation.definitionFit: A single drop of precipitation is the smallest rain shower nature provides.

clue.text: Many a rou will get a duck

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500, many
a roué is a rake, a dissolute man; the accented letter is lost in printing

explanation.surface: Plenty of playboys get nothing in the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rou' is roué, its accented e lost in printing. 'duck' suggests a score of nought in cricket but is the bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A drake is a male duck.

clue.text: Quietly feature fruit

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quietly
an ear is a feature of the face

explanation.surface: Discreetly showcase some fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A pear is a tree fruit.

clue.text: Vegetables with a stone!

parts.note: greens are green vegetables
and means with or plus

explanation.surface: Veg served with a pebble!
explanation.definitionFit: Greensand is a greenish sandstone, a type of rock.

clue.text: A team's confidence in play

parts.note: side is a team; the possessive adds no letter

explanation.surface: A squad's self-belief during a match.
explanation.walkthrough: 'play' suggests sport alongside 'team', but it is a stage play.
explanation.definitionFit: An actor's remark to the audience unheard by others on stage is a confidential stage whisper.

clue.text: Bearing with egghead, a good man

parts.note: the head of egg, its first letter
St, saint, is a good man

explanation.surface: Putting up with an intellectual who is a decent chap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'egghead' means an intellectual on the surface but gives the first letter of egg.
explanation.definitionFit: A compass point is a bearing, a direction.

clue.text: Being superior about one's medico

indicators.note: about means around, so the first piece wraps the second

parts.note: better means superior
ones taken from one's, the apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: Feeling superior about one's doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A bonesetter is a person who resets dislocated or broken bones, a kind of healer.
